comment: Plain scalars that YAML 1.1 reads as numbers (issue #103, wave 018 run 0134), as the command line reads them: `expect` is what `query graph` prints (the references of the elements and the qualifiers that they have) or the one-line error without the file and the place (`file` is the file it names). Each case is a folder: `files` are its files (`workspace.yaml` is `settings: {manifests: {paths: [manifests]}}` when a case does not give it). YamlOneDotOneNumbersTest.java (command line) and yaml-numbers.test.js (editor) run every case; a case that has `editor` is one where the editor says another thing, with the `reason`. The expectations were written from the jar of archicode-0.16.0, which reads these scalars as the jar of this tree does.
